briefdescription.para: Installs an asynchronous handler function for the given handler type.

detaileddescription.para: Sets the handler callback for EmacPs interrupts.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the instance to be worked on.
indicates what interrupt handler type is (XEMACPS_HANDLER_DMASEND, XEMACPS_HANDLER_DMARECV, or XEMACPS_HANDLER_ERROR).
is the pointer to the callback function.
is the upper layer callback reference passed back when the callback function is invoked.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the handler type is valid.

briefdescription.para: Handles EmacPs interrupts and invokes registered user callbacks.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the XEmacPs instance that caused the interrupt.
